positions.name: OwnedVsRentedIntelligenceValue
positions.frame: where does the durable value of intelligence sit — in the substrate that can be rented, or in the perspective that is owned and kept?
positions.why: Both expressions perform the same directional move: a contrastive maxim (register mint 'AphoristicTechnicalMaxim') that opposes something disposable/rented/commodity against something owned/kept, and both are read by the value pass as appeals to autonomy and self-enhancement/competence, and by conviction as principle-level (creed) framing rather than mere claim. src-2 sets the owned/rented opposition abstractly; src-3 maps it onto substrate-vs-perspective with 'the asset you keep' as the pivot phrase. Together they read as one settled directional stance on where retained value resides, even though no tension needs resolving — the two lines simply instantiate the same read at increasing specificity.
